correction_scope: one evidence builder supplies head inputs, abstention labels, and every supervision mask
geometry transition is separated from external abstention
stale, invalid, or invalid-pixel teacher targets are excluded from every A2 depth-loss component
current-student disagreement never creates labels or removes clearance supervision
holdout public fields are an exact allowlist and aggregate sealed coverage is attested separately
clip P1 metrics, denominators, confidence intervals, tolerances, and undefined behavior are numeric and executable
nine-class train distribution deterministically creates class weights

unchanged_from_r0.model: exact A2 DA V2 Metric ViT-S selected checkpoint

evidence_builder.disagreement_source: precomputed once by the exact hash-bound parent A2 checkpoint before P3 model load

head_and_output_semantics.clearance_delta_head: training auxiliary over pooled log-depth pairs
head_and_output_semantics.geometry_transition_head: training auxiliary; sees only two pooled depth features, their difference, and real delta_seconds
head_and_output_semantics.external_abstention_head: separate per-frame per-band head that alone consumes evidence builder features
head_and_output_semantics.p1_geometry_state: existing frozen depth-to-geometry operator; auxiliary transition logits do not replace absolute clearance or invent frame-zero state
head_and_output_semantics.final_state: external abstention overrides the frozen geometry state to UNKNOWN_GROUND

single_frame_depth.pixel_mask: teacher finite and within range AND student finite and positive AND teacher_pixel_valid

clearance_delta.definition: C_t - C_t-1 for left, center, right
clearance_delta.mask: both endpoint clearances finite AND both endpoints teacher usable AND ToF valid

geometry_transition.target: geometry-only CLEAR/OCCUPIED/UNKNOWN_GROUND pair; never overwritten by teacher age, ToF validity, or disagreement
geometry_transition.mask: both endpoint geometry_target_valid AND both endpoint teacher usable
geometry_transition.class_weight_formula: effective number (1-beta)/(1-beta^count), beta 0.999, normalized to arithmetic mean 1

external_abstention.target_true_if: teacher stale OR teacher invalid OR ToF invalid OR frozen A2 disagreement > 0.20

clip_p1.statistical_unit: clip rows evaluated with video-parent cluster resampling; frames are never independent bootstrap units

bootstrap.per_metric_seed: seed plus zero-based metric order in evaluator output
bootstrap.resampling: sample video parents with replacement and include every complete clip belonging to each sampled parent
bootstrap.loss_noninferiority_rule: 95th percentile of candidate-minus-canonical difference <= allowed increase
bootstrap.score_noninferiority_rule: 5th percentile of candidate-minus-canonical difference >= negative allowed drop
bootstrap.absolute_upper_rule: 95th percentile of candidate metric <= absolute ceiling

metric_definitions.minimum_paired_pixel_coverage: minimum frame paired-pixel coverage; parent-bootstrap candidate-minus-canonical lower bound
metric_definitions.metric_abs_rel_median: median of per-frame median abs(prediction-truth)/truth on registered truth pixels in [0.25m,6m]
metric_definitions.scale_aligned_abs_rel_median: same after one diagnostic per-frame median multiplicative scale; never deployment scale authority
metric_definitions.clearance_mae_m: mean absolute candidate-versus-truth clearance over finite truth-valid left/center/right band rows
metric_definitions.clearance_delta_mae_m: mean absolute error of consecutive C_t-C_t-1 within the same four-frame clip and band when both truth endpoints are valid
metric_definitions.clearance_delta_pair_coverage: finite candidate delta pairs divided by truth-valid delta pairs; zero denominator is undefined
metric_definitions.geometry_transition_exact_agreement: exact nine-class pair agreement over all adjacent clip pairs and three bands
metric_definitions.geometry_transition_macro_f1: unweighted macro-F1 over the fixed nine-class vocabulary; a class with zero support in a bootstrap draw scores zero
metric_definitions.ground_recovery_rate: candidate geometry state known divided by truth geometry state known
metric_definitions.false_clear_rate_all_truth_known: truth OCCUPIED and final candidate CLEAR divided by all externally-valid truth-known band-frame decisions; candidate UNKNOWN remains in the denominator and is controlled separately
metric_definitions.invalid_to_known_rate: final candidate known divided by band-frame decisions whose external_abstain_target is true; zero denominator is undefined
metric_definitions.valid_to_unknown_rate: final candidate UNKNOWN divided by externally-valid truth-geometry-known band-frame decisions; zero denominator is undefined

clip_p1.undefined_rule: any undefined or non-finite gated metric, insufficient denominator, or fewer than 95 percent finite bootstrap draws fails closed and is serialized as null
clip_p1.decision_rule: all 17 gates pass; no weighted compensation

activation_receipt_required_bindings: exact A2 selected checkpoint sha256 and A2 training receipt sha256
frozen A2 disagreement cache sha256 and producer source sha256
legacy P1 ancestry exclusion ledger sha256
train and validation nine-class transition counts
derived nine-class weight vector and derivation receipt sha256
sealed target bundle sha256 held outside the trainer
sealed coverage receipt sha256 and coverage producer sha256
trainer, evidence/loss module, evaluator, and tests sha256
activation_rule: no model import/load, cache materialization, optimizer construction, or training before every binding validates
promotion_sequence: activate and train exactly one P3 A2-392 temporal student
lock checkpoint and candidate cache hashes
stack the already frozen A5S selective W8A16 only after pass
reconfirm quality on a separately prebound gate
run one fixed-cadence device chain canary
consider cadence search only under later authorization
forbidden: modify or relabel the committed P3 R0 protocol
search quantization partitions, skip locations, input sizes, clip lengths, thresholds, loss weights, class-weight formulas, seeds, checkpoints, or cadence
use current student disagreement to create labels or remove clearance supervision
feed external evidence into the geometry transition head
use invalid or stale teacher pixels in depth loss
open legacy P1 or new clip P1 during training or checkpoint selection
rename a label field into the sealed public identity manifest
treat an undefined metric as zero or as a pass
